title: ReportingPeriod
description: The bounded interval a Measurement result represents, with an explicit period type and period semantics (CR-MET-011 section 4; Q17). SPECIALIZES dea:TemporalInterval via dea:specializes: the interval clocks are inherited from the CR-6 lineage (valid_from, valid_to, recorded_at, observed_at, planned_start, planned_end, effective_from, effective_to); the period type and period semantics are the specialization payload. The 7 temporal dimensions of CR-MET-011 section 3 MUST NOT be collapsed into one timestamp: observed_at, measured_at, reporting period, valid time, transaction time, effective time, and publication time are distinct facts.

period_type.description: CR-MET-011 section 4: the 7 supported period shapes. instantaneous and point_in_time carry no bounded interval; fixed_duration, rolling, and cumulative carry a bounded interval; event_based is anchored to an event occurrence; irregular carries an explicitly non-uniform interval.

period_semantics.description: CR-MET-011 section 4: the basis on which the period is measured. calendar and fiscal fix the boundaries to a convention; rolling is relative to an anchor; event_based is defined by an occurrence.

period_start.description: Inclusive period start. MUST be null for instantaneous and point_in_time periods; MUST be non-null for fixed_duration, rolling, cumulative, and irregular periods.

period_end.description: Exclusive or inclusive period end as declared by period_semantics. MUST be null for instantaneous and point_in_time periods.

anchor_reference.description: The anchor a rolling or event-based period is measured from. REQUIRED for period_semantics rolling and event_based; MUST be null otherwise.

window_size.description: The rolling window size (e.g. 30d, 12w, 7q). REQUIRED for period_type rolling; MUST be null otherwise.

interval_count.description: Number of irregular sub-intervals composing this period. REQUIRED for period_type irregular; MUST be null otherwise.

calendar_reference.description: The organizational or regulatory calendar that fixes the period boundaries. REQUIRED for period_semantics calendar and fiscal.

fiscal_year_ref.description: The fiscal year the period belongs to. REQUIRED for period_semantics fiscal.

effective_from.description: CR-MET-011 section 3 effective time: when this period definition becomes applicable.

effective_to.description: CR-MET-011 section 3 effective time: when this period definition ceases to apply. null when still current.

organizational_scope_ref.description: The organizational scope in effect during the period (CR-MET-011 section 6). Organizational structure changes MUST NOT retrospectively change the scope of a recorded period.
